human_evidence: Reader reports the span is better, has no skim urge, lighter AI smell, and real suspense, but immediate character motives are hard to understand and the result feels uncomfortable/opaque rather than cleanly mysterious.
diagnosis: Too many unknowns are active at the same narrative layer. The reader lacks a stable answer to what each principal character wants right now, so unresolved larger-truth questions are experienced as confusion instead of suspense.

reader_should_know_now: what each principal character is trying to do in the current scene
what immediate consequence they are trying to cause or prevent
why the next physical action makes sense
reader_may_not_know_yet: who ultimately falsified or manipulated the past record
the full truth behind the clue

repair_rule: Preserve one central unresolved mystery while resolving local action motive. Do not solve opacity by adding exposition packets or interview-style Q&A.
scale_gate: No second span growth until an actual human says immediate motives are clear enough while suspense remains.
